Thanks for the packet — we reviewed the mapping and it's a good starting point. A couple clarifying items:

1) Preferred upload: we can accept evidence two ways — a secure SFTP (preferred for structured evidence) or a Drive link to a dedicated folder with limited access. SFTP will give us better ingestion guarantees.
2) SLA: standard intake SLA is 3 business days to process and index artifacts; expedited (24–48 hours) is available for critical items with a $500 fee.
